summary_zh: 让 Claude、ChatGPT 等 AI 助手通过 MCP 连接 Home Assistant，用自然语言搜索并控制实体、创建和修改自动化与脚本、编辑仪表板、查看历史与调试执行轨迹，并提供备份、只读模式等安全选项。
audience_zh: 适合希望用 AI 助手简化和自动化 Home Assistant 配置与日常控制的家居用户，尤其是希望通过 HACS 集成或插件方式部署，并使用 Claude、ChatGPT 等 MCP 客户端的用户。

evidence.quote: Configure and automate Home Assistant with Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI assistants.

The recommended way to run ha-mcp is the **HA-MCP integration**. It installs into Home Assistant through HACS (the built-in Marketplace on Home Assistant 2026.11+), runs the full server **in-process**, and works on **every** Home Assistant installation type — Home Assistant OS, Supervised, Container
# HA-MCP — Manage Home Assistant with AI

**Connect URL.** The Configure screen gives you a Home Assistant webhook URL for remote clients — `https://<your-ha-domain>/api/webhook/<webhook-id>` through Nabu Casa or any reverse proxy already pointed at Home Assistant (locally, `http://<ha-host>:8123/api/webhook/<webhook-id>`).
